title: SNMP: Allow for key expansion algorithm selection
description:
The privacy protocol key size may be larger than what can be provided.
The algorithm by which the key is to be expanded is not standardized.
Add the selection of the used algorithm to the SNMP user table.
Add a second key expansion algorithm, as implemented by AGENT++,
besides the commonly used IETF draft 3DES-EDE for USM.

Closes #19916
